fusions.name: Chilled Peck
fusions.desc: Breathes out a cold cone 3 tiles long, dealing 3 damage to everything in it, each with a 30% chance of [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Dropped Tail
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health. Flings a writhing tail into the first enemy it meets for 9 damage, with a 30% chance of [Stunned] for 1 second.

fusions.name: Basking Ledge
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 10 seconds. You move 15% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Daylight Reflexes
fusions.desc: By day, your dodge chance rises by 10%.
